stories.title: Scott Colom
stories.summary: After a week of counting affidavit ballots, the Associated Press and CNN project the election to the U.S. Senate in Mississippi for Democratic candidate Scott Colom, defeating the incumbent Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith and becoming the first black senator from the state since Blanche Bruce in the 1874–75 elections.
stories.about: Scott Winston Colom is an American politician, lawyer, and jurist who is a United States senator-elect from Mississippi. A member of the Democratic Party, Colom has served as district attorney for the 16th Judicial District of Mississippi since 2016.

stories.title: Stacy Keach
stories.about: Walter Stacy Keach Jr. was an American actor. He was the elder son of theatre director Stacy Keach Sr., and the brother of actor James Keach. Known for his roles on stage and screen, his accolades include four Drama Desk Awards and a Golden Globe Award, as well as nominations for a Primetime Emmy Award and Tony Award. He is an inductee of the Theatre Hall of Fame and was honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 2019.
